payload.title: Mouse connected through a dock cannot wake the suspended host

expectation.text: Movement or a button press from a Logitech mouse using a Unifying receiver through the dock should wake the suspended host, and the corrected custom lid policy should not immediately request another suspend after resume.

payload.observed: The private journal records a receiver-triggered wake helper and a restart of the corrected custom lid-policy service, followed by the stated active behavior. It does not record a complete wake-cycle test protocol or isolate the two interventions.
